title: Like or Like Like
lyrics:
[00:11.00]I watched you through your window
[00:14.01]I was wearin' that dumb sweatshirt
[00:16.35]I looked like a goon
[00:21.68]I was dressed for winter
[00:22.93]Even though it was the middle of June
[00:31.33]I watched you get undressed
[00:34.00]I must have turned bright red
[00:36.07]'Cause I couldn't stand to face you
[00:41.49]'Cause I liked what I saw
[00:43.00]Maybe we should just stay friends
[00:50.49]Tell me how you feel about me
[00:52.91]Do you like or like like me?
[00:55.38]Tell me what you really feel
[00:57.79]Do you like me? (Ooh)
[00:59.76]Just say you do
[01:10.33]I climbed up your front porch
[01:13.88]And I doorbell ditched you
[01:16.45]And I felt so bad, ooh
[01:21.15]Couldn't cop to what I did
[01:22.72]So I laughed myself sick all the way to my car, oh
[01:30.40]Tell me how you feel about me
[01:32.78]Do you like or like like me?
[01:35.14]Tell me what you really feel
[01:37.91]Do you like me? (Ooh)
[01:40.39]Just say you do
